General.Description:
Commander Lucia Sanz has spent fifteen years as the most reliable asset in NATO's shadow operations division. She does not ask questions. She delivers results. But when a mission to neutralise a terrorist cell in Istanbul goes catastrophically wrong — and her own agency disavows her in real time — Sanz is left alone in a hostile city with no backup, no cover identity, and a target on her back.

Midnight Strike is a pulse-pounding black-ops thriller that races across three continents in seventy-two hours. Elena Vasquez draws on her background in international security consulting to craft a story that feels ripped from the headlines — complete with double agents, encrypted communications, and the murky ethics of state-sanctioned violence.

As Sanz fights her way toward the truth, she uncovers a conspiracy that reaches far higher than a single rogue cell. Someone within the alliance itself has been feeding information to the enemy, and the evidence points to a name she never expected.

Tense, intelligent, and relentlessly paced, Midnight Strike is the first book in the Commander Sanz series and marks the arrival of a major new voice in the action thriller genre.
